items.title: Commit the reviewed executable done_prepare/DONE parity RED and register it
items.context: Candidate probe rp-mtn2kjzu-pap3kp and red review rr-mtn2kqun-vcqatu bind the exact executable design; red/green relation rgr-mtn2ppnx-h2nqoj and passing evaluation rgre-mtn2ptyg-asgnhf bind the same command to current-main RED and isolated-candidate GREEN. Before implementation, the test exits 1 because the real DONE guard rejects missing dev_memory_finish_decision and stale scopeBinding.diffPackHash while buildDoneClosureRunbook has neither blocker row. The already-run GREEN candidate proves the unchanged test can pass after the parity fix, but DEV must commit this test and rerun it in the Story worktree.

excludes: Do not replace the test with static source-string assertions.

happy.desc: The committed behavior test drives the done_prepare closure runbook and real DONE guard on identical state and ends with the exact GREEN parity summary.

items.title: Make done_prepare consume the real DONE finish-decision and reviewer-verdict predicates
items.context: The production path is done_prepare -> buildDoneClosureRunbook -> buildDoneChecklist, while machine.ts independently enforces readDevMemoryFinishDecision and evaluateReviewVerdict. Implement the smallest shared or mechanically parity-guarded path so done_prepare blocks before recommending DONE. Stale evidence is reported, never refreshed, re-signed, rebound, or fabricated. The temporary candidate that added dev-memory-finish-decision and review-verdict rows is feasibility evidence, not the required final design.
items.userSees: done_prepare reports missing_dev_memory_finish_decision before suggesting DONE, and reports stale_closeout_review with diff_pack_changed when the real DONE gate would reject the same reviewer pass
excludes: Do not change which finish-decision values satisfy DONE.
Do not weaken or bypass evaluateReviewVerdict.
Do not change B-c86f dev-memory path classification.
Do not automatically create reviewer passes or mutate reviewer evidence.

happy.desc: With every other fixture condition held constant, a missing finish decision makes both real DONE and the done_prepare runbook fail with missing_dev_memory_finish_decision.

verification.selector: GREEN parity: done_prepare oracle rejects the missing finish decision with the same code

edge.desc: A signed reviewer pass whose live scope diff changes while HEAD/materialHash stay fixed makes both surfaces fail with diff_pack_changed mapped to stale_closeout_review.

verification.selector: GREEN parity: done_prepare oracle rejects the same stale lane diffPackHash with stale_closeout_review

adversarial.desc: The done_prepare/runbook path remains read-only and never rewrites or re-endorses the stale reviewer pass while surfacing the blocker.

verification.selector: GREEN adversarial: done_prepare parity evaluation leaves reviewer evidence and git state unchanged

items.title: Mechanically guard DONE/preflight parity and document bounded defect triage
items.context: DONE gate evidence and reviewer-pass behavior are process facts, so update the process-fact registry and verifier together with a same-source/parity regression. During all DEV/REVIEW/TEST work, classify new defects before changing scope: current repair is mandatory for critical/high, safety/data-integrity/destructive-compatibility, acceptance-blocking, or lifecycle-gate-truth defects; medium/low nonblockers require reproducible evidence, impact, recommended treatment, and a traceable finding/gap/backlog owner, and must return to the current Story if later evidence upgrades severity or applicability.
items.userSees: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs exits 0, flow-stability smoke passes, and the done_prepare decision document states that its final readiness result consumes the same finish-decision and reviewer-verdict predicates as DONE
excludes: Do not broaden the Story to repair unrelated medium/low findings.
Do not dismiss or defer a finding through prose alone.
Do not duplicate every DONE gate implementation in a second oracle without a mechanical parity guard.
Do not change unrelated lifecycle policy.

happy.desc: The process-fact contract registers done_prepare consumption of finish-decision presence and the phase-agnostic reviewer verdict, and its verifier passes.

edge.desc: The existing shared DONE-oracle flow-stability suite remains green after adding the two blocker rows and guards the done_prepare/runbook consumer path.

adversarial.desc: A future change that removes either finish-decision or reviewer-verdict consumption from done_prepare fails a committed mechanical contract instead of allowing a false PASS.
